<title Refills [G_refill] /> Magazine from reserves upon dropping to {{30%}{<enhanced/>35%}} Shield Health. Can activate while stowed and persists through stow.

Grants 50 Handling and 5% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration while at or below {{30%}{<enhanced/>35%}} Shield Health.

The buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

enhanced (
<enhanced/> Shield Health threshold is increased (30%<arrow/>35%).

source.text:
Upon reaching 30% ↑35% Shield HP:
Refills Weapon. Grants +50 Handling, and 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier.
Buff lasts until Shield HP is restored above 30% ↑35%, then lingers for 1 second.
Buff can be activated while stowed, and persists through stow.
